citations.B1: Read-then-write on `count`/`counts[user_id]` across threads — race lets concurrent requests both pass
citations.B3: fix with an atomic increment or a per-user lock
citations.B4: No window/expiry — once a user hits 100 they're blocked forever, not per-second/minute; fix by adding a time window
citations.B5: `counts` dict grows unbounded — every distinct `user_id` ever seen stays in memory forever
citations.B6: `counts` is per-process, not shared — multi-worker deployment lets each worker grant its own 100, so real limit is 100×workers
citations.B7: No input validation on `user_id` — `None`/unhashable/malicious values throw or collide
